survey.summary:
pnpm workspace on Cloudflare Workers: server/ (Hono + GraphQL Yoga + Pothos, D1, a Durable Object per team), web/ (Preact board, server-rendered by a Hono Worker) and ui/ (shared Preact components).
A pure rules engine in server/src/domain sorts each person's Linear issues into Eisenhower quadrants and derives weather, a forecast and rebalance moves, exposed as derived fields on mirrored Linear types.
Around it: a rate-limited Linear client, OAuth sign-in, a demo workspace, live updates from Linear webhooks over SSE, trusted documents and query limits.

vocabulary.quadrant: Do, Schedule, Delegate or Drop: where an issue sits in the Eisenhower matrix
vocabulary.sorting rules: a team's rules for what counts as important and urgent (quadrant_rules)
vocabulary.hand placement: a PM's override of an issue's quadrant
vocabulary.backlog rot: too much of a team's open work sitting in Drop
vocabulary.weather: a person's urgent load against their fair share (sunny to storm), or away
vocabulary.fair share: the team average, scaled by a person's capacity
vocabulary.forecast: the weather week by week ahead, from due dates; fog is undated work
vocabulary.capacity: how much of a full-time week a person works
vocabulary.time off / away status: ranges added on the board, or a Linear status the team lists as away
vocabulary.rebalance: suggested reassignments that clear today's storm or the ones ahead, applied in Linear
vocabulary.board: the PM's web page showing the team

sorting.purpose: Putting issues into quadrants: sorting rules per team, hand placements, each person's matrix, backlog rot

weather.purpose: Who is overloaded and what to do about it: weather now, the forecast and fog, capacity, time off, away statuses, rebalance, the sky

linear.purpose: Talking to Linear: the rate-limited client, paged queries, batching, reassigning, webhooks into live board updates, and the demo workspace that stands in for Linear

api.purpose: Our GraphQL server: schema, mutation error unions, trusted documents, query limits, D1 storage, sign-in and sessions

board.purpose: The web app around the board: the SSR worker, board shell, team picker, sign-in page, /about and /privacy, the client data layer and shared UI
